Public splitlib tables from static version 1.293.0, verified against the CDN
archive size and MD5 recorded in `extension/tower-rules.js`. The fixture files
retain their original bytes; SHA-256 values are checked by the parser tests.

Refresh these two files together with generated Tower rules when the game's
`indexGet` references a new splitlib archive. See the Knowns document
`architecture/tower-floor-count-from-splitlib` for extraction and validation.
